questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by four conclusions numbered 1, 2, 3, and 4. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically does NOT follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Nights are Lights

No Light is a Van.

All Vans are Whips.

**Conclusions:**

1) Some Nights are not Vans.

2) No Van is a Light.

3) Some Whips are not Lights.

4) Some Nights are Whips.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is shown below: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9aaf61bfdb9a3172d24972dee1c36ab6fc75582267b00e3cccd07839e7cf4e1.png] 

**Conclusions:**

1. Some Nights are not Vans → True (as some nights are lights not vans. as shown in the venn diagram)

2. No Van is a Light → True ( as there is no definite relation between van and light so, no van is a light)

3. Some Whips are not Lights → True (no light is a van so no lights are whips as shown above)

4. Some Nights are Whips → False ( it is possible but not definite as there is no relation between nights and whips)

Hence, **"Only conclusion 4 does not follow" **is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 31 December 2003 was a Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 7 March 2005?
questions.solution:
As we know, 2004 is a leap year and so it has 2 odd days.

Given:

31st Dec 2003 is Wednesday,

Next, 1st Jan 2004 to 31st Dec 2004 = 2 odd days.

So, 31st Dec 2004 will be Wednesday + 2 = Friday.

Now, in the year 2005, no of days

= (31) Jan + (28) Feb + (7) Mar = 66 days = 9 weeks 3 days

So, 7th March 2005 = Friday + 3 = Monday

Thus, it was **Monday** on 7th March 2005.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.

After filling the blanks with the letters in the options one by one we get,

1. F U ***__T__*** U ***__R__*** E /__*** F ***__U T ***__U__*** ***__R__*** E / F__*** U***__ T *__**U **__*R E/ ***__F U __***T U ***__R__*** E → follows a pattern

questions.question: Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north. Only two people sit to the right of U. Only two people sit to the left of R. Only two people sit between U and Q. Only three people sit between R and V. T is not an immediate neighbour of U. S sits to the right of U. Who sits to the immediate right of U?
questions.solution:
Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north

Step 1: Only two people sit to the right of U.

Step 2: Only two people sit to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/932d5fcf91727b8748d28a7dd8f2294d58dbf135476f5487184c339ec1ee64bf.png] 

Step 3: Only two people sit between U and Q. 

Step 4: Only three people sit between R and V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb7d89902780cdfb3994809dbe6cf102e156ed5491474b7cc815a32f4b78362e.png] 

Step 5: T is not an immediate neighbour of U. 

Step 6: S sits to the right of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1d0a2da0fb3dc7d5fa37dd4b010ee1e0a2eae2a2fd1bdb4ec6e14db8445a714.png] 

According to the arrangement, **S sits to the immediate right of U.**

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '3'.

Hence, **"Option 1" **is the correct answer.
